main_text.p: Tristitia de bonis alterius; Cupiditas eorum quae sunt proximi; Appetitus immodicus gloriae, voluptatum, opum, aliorumque ejusmodi, praesertim illicitorum. Gal.5.v.17. Jac.1.v.14.
Irascentis facultatis affectus sunt: Ira, Zelus, Vindicta. Rom.12. v.18. Ephes. 4.v.26.32.
Peccatur itaque: Iracundia, Vindictae privatae studio, zelotypia ac zelo abscientia, reliquisque hujusmodi pravis affectibus. Rom.10. v.2. & 12.v.19. Eph.4. v.31.
Atq; ista huc-usq; de S Theologia & Verbo Dei, in doctrina Fidei Morumq; Christianorum; ad Dei gloriam, majoremq; in Pietatis studio progressum, tractata sunto.

page.notes: Printed ornament (fleuron) below the text and a small decorative woodcut are not transcribed. Show-through from the reverse page is visible faintly and omitted. Some words in the Latin "Peccatur itaque" line are partly obscured by the gutter; "abscientia" reads as printed but may be "abscisa"-like; uncertain readings are not marked further.
